description: 西西里那科多夫变例 B90 — 侧翼引爆：a6为b5铺路的经典反制

intro.popup_en:
Counterattack the Center, Lesson 4: Sicilian Najdorf
The Najdorf move ...a6 may look modest, but it prepares ...b5. Black uses a queenside pawn break to create counterplay alongside the central fight. When is the best moment to advance ...b5?
intro.popup:
反制中心第4课

那科多夫变例！

a6看似小棋
实则意义深远！

为b5推进铺路
侧翼引爆中心

核心问题：
b5的最佳时机？

outro.popup_en: ...a6 prevents Nb5 and prepares ...b5, turning the queenside into a source of counterplay. The Najdorf plan combines central pressure with a timely queenside break and an opposite-side attacking race.
outro.popup:
那科多夫总结

a6的战略价值：
① 防Nb5
② 为b5铺路
③ 侧翼引爆策略

那科多夫三大要素：
① e5争夺中心
② b5侧翼爆破
③ 对攻节奏
